steps.note: 28 Aug: US military alert, 1 in 50,000. ESA emails SpaceX; SpaceX replies it has no plans to move.
29 Aug: risk crosses ESA's 1 in 10,000 threshold.
1 Sep: risk about 1 in 1,000. A paging-system bug means the follow-up is never seen.
2 Sep: Aeolus burns alone, half an orbit before closest approach. No shared record.
